title: Credential-harvesting form
summary: A form asks for login, payment, or identity data under a familiar brand.
scenario: The form is reached through an unexpected message or an unfamiliar destination.
warning_signs: Unusual combination of secrets and identity data
No clear reason for the request
safe_actions: Close the form and open the service through a known route
Do not reuse a password on an unverified page
Ask the organization through independently found contact details
recovery_guidance: Change any submitted credentials immediately through the real service
Contact payment or identity providers if relevant
reporting_guidance: Keep the form URL and message without submitting more data
prevention_tips: Check the domain and certificate context before sign-in
Use unique passwords and multi-factor protection
false_positive_notes: A real form may request personal information, but its destination and purpose should be independently confirmed.
